limitations: Opt-in preview C compiles ASP with direct ASPCOMP under quiesced foreground ownership. It does not execute a script, publish active selected-entry/resources/UART state or dial.

Component faults use an explicit DOS spawning adapter and a separately identified fault child. Actual parent process_run, memory restoration and UART handoff are covered separately in foreground DOS tests.
Compiled-header validation is not complete bytecode validation. CRC32 detects observed changes; it does not authenticate a helper or lock external writers and namespace replacement.
ENiGMA exact_screen covers final frame dimensions and markers; it is not an independent full character/attribute oracle. Online C refusal and command non-leakage are separately checked.
Proxy evidence uses isolated loopback software with paced serial delivery. No physical CTS, SIP, DSP, analog or card acceptance.
Full F01-F16 application scope remains open.
